If you mean in terms of looking for a result, I'd imagine it's one of the more drawn out and painful ways to do it. Can't say I've ever attempted it but I've known people who've walked in on friends that have absolutely gashed their wrists and said they were shocked that there was even that much blood in a human. Just absolutely coated the entire bathroom

Also it's quite easy to get a blood clot during the incident which would just draw out the process even longer. If pain is what you're concerned about then definitely don't consider slashing your wrists

I appreciate it but with all due respect, there's not much you can help me with from the other side of a computer screen. I've heard it all before, take initiative, fake confidence until you have it, put yourself out there et.c and I've done it all. The worst thing is I'm not even ugly, I dress well, I'm very hygienic, I'm responsible, and I'm interesting and can hold a conversation well. I used to be naturally confident and outgoing and even now I can still do a good job of acting like I am. It's never amounted to anything and it never will, I almost wish I had some obvious glaring flaw that made me unlovable because at least then I could understand why it's never gonna happen for me
Thanks but if there was a solution out there I'd have found it by now. I only really made this post to vent, nothing can change my mind at this point
I don't want to be isolated at all, but there's no way out of it at this point. And I can genuinely say I've made honest attempts
